newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sanyo Sec asks insurers to postpone debt repayment.
newsitem.headline: Sanyo Sec asks insurers to postpone debt repayment.

text.p: Sanyo Securities Co Ltd said on Friday it asked several life insurance companies for a postponement of repayment of its subordinated debts due at the end of July.

A company spokesman said that the medium-sized brokerage has a total of 20 billion yen in subordinated loans from the life insurers, including Nippon Life Insurance Co. He did not disclose how much of that amount was due for repayment later this month.
"We are confident that the request for the delay in repayment will be approved by the lenders," said the spokesman.
